DHB.Automatisation.Aucune: No automation yet: the item behaves as dnd5e defines it.
DHB.Automatisation.Base: Keep the automation taken from the starting item ({keys})
DHB.Automatisation.Inconnue: Automation "{type}" is unknown to this version of the engine: it will be ignored.
DHB.Automatisation.NiveauInsuffisant: The engine's automation level is not "Full": your creations are saved but do not apply in game (DAS · Core settings).
DHB.Automatisation.PasEnregistre: The automation has errors: nothing was saved.
DHB.Automatisation.Vide: Nothing to automate: the item keeps dnd5e's behavior.
DHB.Condition.NonAide: Checked: the condition must be false.
DHB.Depart.Deposer: Drop an item here (spell, feature, item…) from a compendium or a sheet.
DHB.Depart.Explication: Starting from an existing item keeps its activities, effects and automation: you only change what differs.
DHB.Depart.PasUnObjet: Only an Item can be used as a template.
DHB.Depart.Vierge: Without a template, "Next" starts from a blank item.
DHB.Identite.DejaAutomatise: "{id}" is already automated by the engine or another module: tick the box to replace it in this world.
DHB.Identite.DejaCree: A creation already uses the identifier "{id}".
DHB.Identite.IdentifiantAide: This is how the engine recognizes the item, on every sheet it is placed on. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
DHB.Identite.IdentifiantFaux: The identifier only contains lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
DHB.Identite.Remplacer: Deliberately replace the existing automation of "{id}" in this world.
DHB.Natif.Explication: The item is created in the Homebrew compendium. On its sheet, set what dnd5e handles on its own: activities (attack, save, damage, healing, summon…), range, area, effects. The next step's automation builds on them.
DHB.Natif.Introuvable: This creation's item cannot be found (compendium deleted?).
DHB.Natif.Revenir: Come back here afterwards: the activities and effects you created will appear in the choices.
DHB.Pack.Absent: This world's Homebrew compendium cannot be found.
DHB.Pack.Created: DAS · Homebrew: compendium "{label}" created in this world.
DHB.Pack.Label: Homebrew (DAS)
DHB.Refus.MJSeul: Only the GM can create automated items.
DHB.Refus.Moteur: The DAS · Core engine (dnd5e-combat) is missing or too old: the creator needs its recipe catalogue.
DHB.Paquet.Explication: A pack only holds rules, keyed by item identifier: it automates items this world already has (spells, features, items from a module) without bringing their text. Workshop creations take precedence over packs, and the GM's world overlay over everything.
DHB.Paquet.Deposer: Drop a pack file (.json) here, or use "Import a pack".
DHB.Paquet.Activer: Enable or disable this pack in this world
DHB.Paquet.RetirerConfirmer: Remove "{title}" from this world? Its rules stop applying at once.
DHB.Paquet.RetirerItems: Also delete its {n} item(s) from the Homebrew compendium
DHB.Paquet.Etat.ContentVersion: written for version {pack} of the DAS · Core schema, which is at version {engine}
DHB.Paquet.Etat.SourcesUnsupported: this version of DAS · Core cannot register the pack's sources: items without an identifier will not be recognized
DHB.Paquet.Inactif: DAS · Homebrew: pack "{title}" is not applied — {why}.
DHB.Paquet.Affaibli: DAS · Homebrew: pack "{title}" only partly applies — {why}.
DHB.Paquet.Illisible: This file is not a readable pack.
DHB.Paquet.Decision.same: same version as the one already imported: it will be replaced
DHB.Paquet.Decision.downgrade: older than the imported version ({previous}): it will replace it
DHB.Paquet.SeraInactif: The pack will be imported, but will not apply:
DHB.Paquet.Refuse: Cannot import: the pack has errors.
DHB.Paquet.ConflitsAide: In order of priority: the last source wins, key by key.
DHB.Paquet.ItemsAide: The pack's items will be created in the Homebrew compendium, in a folder named after it; an update replaces them.
DHB.Paquet.ImporteInactif: "{title}" is imported but inactive in this world: see the pack list.
DHB.Paquet.Export.Explication: The pack holds the rules of the chosen creations (and, if you wish, their items). It is imported into another world from this same window.
DHB.Paquet.Export.IdAide: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; derived from the title.
DHB.Paquet.Export.ItemsAide: An item created from another module's item keeps its text and image: do not share such a pack unless they are free to share.
DHB.Paquet.Export.Module: Export "as a module" (a ready-to-publish .zip) will come later.
DHB.Paquet.Export.Ecartees: Creations without a valid rule, left out of the export: {ids}
DHB.Paquet.Export.Vide: Nothing to export: none of the chosen creations has a valid rule.
DHB.Paquet.Erreur.NotJson: the file is not valid JSON ({message})
DHB.Paquet.Erreur.NotObject: the file does not contain an object
DHB.Paquet.Erreur.Format: this is not a DAS pack (format "{format}", expected "das-pack")
DHB.Paquet.Erreur.FormatVersion: "formatVersion" is missing or not an integer
DHB.Paquet.Erreur.FormatNewer: pack in format {version}, newer than this workshop's ({current}): update DAS · Homebrew
DHB.Paquet.Erreur.FormatNoMigration: format {version} is too old, no known conversion
DHB.Paquet.Erreur.Id: pack id "{id}": lowercase letters, digits and dashes
DHB.Paquet.Erreur.Title: the title is required
DHB.Reglages.Menu.Aide: Automation packs and the item creator.
DHB.Reglages.Paquets.Aide: Import a pack (.json), enable or disable it, update it, remove it, export it; export your creations as a pack.
DHB.Reglages.Createur.Aide: Create an automated spell, feature or item, step by step.
